places.name: North Platte River
places.note: The herd trails west along it for days; where it bends south toward Colorado, Call turns northwest and Po Campo lingers sadly at the water.
places.location_hint: followed west from near Ogallala until it curves south toward Colorado

places.name: Clara's ranch
places.note: Newt praises the horse-breaking woman there; Dish is upset Augustus left Lorena behind.
places.location_hint: on the Platte near Ogallala, Nebraska

places.name: Nebraska
places.note: Its plains had good grass and many antelope, unlike the drier land beyond; the wolf seen after the picnic was there.

places.name: Wyoming
places.note: As they enter it the grass thins and water turns scarce and alkaline; a sandstorm hits the herd on its plain.

places.name: Waterless stretch east of Salt Creek
places.note: About eighty miles without water; the herd struggles through a night sandstorm, thirst-blinded cattle, and Deets leads the dozing Call's horse.
places.location_hint: pale sandy plain in Wyoming between the last small stream northwest of the Platte and Salt Creek, roughly eighty miles across

places.name: Salt Creek
places.note: Call scouts it alone, finding pools of poor water; the herd reaches it after the drought, losing only six head.
places.location_hint: Wyoming; a tributary leading to the Powder River, about eighty miles west of the previous water

places.name: Colorado
places.note: The Platte curves south toward it, where the herd leaves the river.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Hands recall only a drunk there and complain of its beer; locals warned them Montana meant death.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: Its grass was far richer than the Wyoming country.

places.name: Pecos River
places.note: Augustus compares the alkaline streams to it.

places.name: Powder River
places.note: Call aims to reach it via Salt Creek, then follow it north into Montana.

places.name: Montana
places.note: Augustus wonders if Jake lied about it; Call wants to be first to graze cattle there.

places.name: Rocky Mountains
places.note: Mountains glimpsed far north from Salt Creek; Augustus names them; Call says they won't climb them but go north up the Powder.
places.location_hint: seen far to the north of Salt Creek

places.name: Yellowstone River
places.note: Call estimates about three weeks to reach it; the camp falls silent at the name.

places.name: Canadian River
places.note: Where Blue Duck killed Po Campo's sons.

places.name: New Mexico
places.note: Po Campo's sons lie buried there.

places.name: Llano Estacado
places.note: Blue Duck still roams it; Call and Deets campaigned there, Call riding a mule named Ben.
places.location_hint: high plains of west Texas and eastern New Mexico

places.name: Columbia River
places.note: Po Campo once described its great gorge.

places.name: Ireland
places.note: The Irishman still weeps for it and his wife.

places.name: Texas
places.note: Deets misses its orderly life; Jasper wishes he'd stayed there.

places.name: San Antonio
places.note: Deets enjoyed his trips there to bank the outfit's money.

places.name: Fort Phantom Hill
places.note: Half-asleep, Call dreams he is fighting that old battle again.

groups.label: Hat Creek outfit
groups.hint: resting the herd on Salt Creek in Wyoming after the eighty-mile dry drive, mountains visible to the north
